title: The car race / When were they there?
subtitle: 汽车比赛 / 他们那时在哪儿？

lead.question: 你参加过或围观过赛车吗？如果有人问你「1995 年那场比赛谁赢了、当时你在哪儿」，你会用英语怎么回答？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象一场热闹的镇上赛车：人群、各国汽车、冲线瞬间。叙述者用过去时回忆「1995 年有一场大赛、我们站在左边、15 号车赢了」。注意 be 动词的过去式 was/were——单数用 was，复数用 were。第 70 课把 was/were 套进「Where were you …?」的句式，配合具体日期和地点反复操练。
goals: 认识一般过去时 be 动词 was / were 的形式与用法
能用 There was / There were 描述过去存在的人或物
能用 Where were you / they …? 询问过去所在地点，并用 We / They were at(in) … 回答
理解 car number fifteen、on the left、on the way home 等表达
lead.summary: 第 69 课是一段回忆：叙述者镇上每年有赛车，1995 年有一场盛大赛事，20 辆车参赛，15 号车（比利·斯图尔特）夺冠；回家路上妻子笑他「别开得像冠军那么快」。全课用 was/were 铺开过去时。第 70 课用 Where were you and … on …? 操练 was/were 与地点、时间状语（Monday, April, 1990 等）。
lead.tips: ① 单数/不可数用 was，复数用 were；② There was a race（单数）/ There were twenty cars（复数）；③ hundreds of people 成百上千的人；④ on the left 在左边；⑤ car number fifteen 第 15 号车；⑥ on the way home 在回家路上。

questions.q: Which car was the winner in 1995?
questions.zh: 哪辆车在 1995 年的比赛中获胜？
questions.aZh: 15 号车（比利·斯图尔特的赛车）。
questions.hint: 听 The winner was Billy Stewart. He was in car number fifteen.

questions.q: How many cars were there in the race?
questions.zh: 比赛里一共有多少辆汽车？
questions.hint: There were twenty cars in the race.

questions.q: Where are the narrator and his wife in the photograph?
questions.zh: 照片里叙述者和他妻子站在哪儿？
questions.a: They are standing on the left, in the crowd.
questions.aZh: 他们站在左边的人群里。
questions.hint: You can see us in the crowd. We are standing on the left.

questions.q: What did the narrator's wife say on the way home?
questions.zh: 叙述者的妻子在回家路上说了什么？
questions.a: Don't drive so quickly! You're not Billy Stewart!
questions.aZh: 别开得这么快！你可不是比利·斯图尔特！
questions.hint: On the way home, my wife said to me …

questions.q: Why do you think the wife says 'You're not Billy Stewart'?
questions.zh: 你觉得妻子为什么说「你可不是比利·斯图尔特」？
questions.a: It is a joke — Billy Stewart was the racing champion who drove fast, but the narrator is just an ordinary driver, so his wife teases him not to drive like a racer.
questions.aZh: 这是句玩笑——比利·斯图尔特是开得飞快的冠军车手，而叙述者只是普通人，妻子调侃他别像赛车手那样开。
questions.hint: 想一想赛车夺冠的语境和夫妻间的调侃。

questions.q: Where were you and ___ on ___? — We were at ___ on ___.
questions.zh: 你和……在……（日期）在哪儿？——我们（在……）在……（地点）。（用 was/were 的过去式操练地点与时间）
questions.a: Where were you and Susan on March 23rd? We were at the office on March 23rd.
questions.aZh: 你和苏珊 3 月 23 日在哪儿？我们那天在办公室。
questions.hint: 过去地点问句用 were；回答 at/in + 地点。

lines.en: There is a car race near our town every year.
lines.zh: 我们镇子附近每年都有一场汽车比赛。

lines.en: In 1995, there was a very big race.
lines.zh: 1995 年举行了一次盛大的比赛。

lines.en: There were hundreds of people there. My wife and I were at the race.
lines.zh: 许许多多人都去了赛场。我和我的妻子也去了。
lines.note: were 是 are 的过去式，表过去状态。

lines.en: Our friends, Julie and Jack were there, too. You can see us in the crowd. We are standing on the left.
lines.zh: 我们的朋友朱莉和杰克也去了。你可以在人群中看到我们。我们站在左面。

lines.en: There were twenty cars in the race. There were English cars, French cars, German cars, Italian cars, American cars and Japanese cars.
lines.zh: 参加比赛的有 20 辆汽车。有英国、法国、德国、意大利、美国和日本的汽车。
lines.note: There were + 复数名词，表过去存在。

lines.en: It was an exciting finish. The winner was Billy Stewart. He was in car number fifteen. Five other cars were just behind him.
lines.zh: 比赛的结尾是激动人心的。获胜者是比利·斯图尔特。他在第 15 号车里。其他 5 辆汽车跟在他后面。

lines.en: On the way home, my wife said to me, "Don't drive so quickly! You're not Billy Stewart!"
lines.zh: 在回家的途中，我妻子对我说："别开得这样快！你可不是比利·斯图尔特！"
lines.note: car number fifteen 第 15 号车。

grammar.title: 一般过去时 be 动词 (was / were)
grammar.definition: be 动词的过去式：am/is → was，are → were。用于描述过去的状态、身份或位置。
grammar.usage: 单数主语（I/he/she/it 及单数名词）用 was；复数主语（we/you/they 及复数名词）用 were。

examples.en: My wife and I were at the race.
examples.zh: 我和我的妻子也去了（赛场）。

examples.en: The winner was Billy Stewart.
examples.zh: 获胜者是比利·斯图尔特。

grammar.title: There was / There were（过去存在）
grammar.structure: There was + 单数/不可数名词；There were + 复数名词
grammar.definition: there be 句型的过去式，表示过去某时某处有某物。
grammar.usage: 讲述过去场景中「有……」时用；与现在时 There is/are 对应。

examples.en: There was a very big race in 1995.
examples.zh: 1995 年有一场盛大的比赛。

examples.en: There were hundreds of people there.
examples.zh: 那儿有许许多多的人。

examples.en: There is a car race near our town every year.
examples.zh: 我们镇子附近每年都有一场汽车比赛。

examples.en: He was in car number fifteen.
examples.zh: 他在第 15 号车里。

examples.en: We are standing on the left.
examples.zh: 我们站在左面。

examples.en: On the way home, my wife said to me …
examples.zh: 在回家的路上，我妻子对我说……
